Resolves #20629

`NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` now opens the overflow menu before it reads the bar, then polls one snapshot of the bar and the menu. While the menu is open, `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` parks every projection, so both reads describe one partition. Before, the spec read the bar first, and a projection that landed before the menu opened could move a tab out of both reads. That is how `e2e-engine (12/14)` on #20621 missed Medium.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium e2e against the dev server, including a projection forced between the reads) → L3 required (the ticket's three ACs). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — the spec's read order changes; no product code.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Both phone tests call `openOverflowMenu()` before `reachableTabs()`, which reads the bar and the menu in one `page.evaluate`. The desktop test has no control, so it reads the bar alone. |
| AC-2 | Probe at CPU 4×, 390×600, then 780. With the resize between the bar read and the menu read, the old order missed Medium 3/3. With the committed helpers copied verbatim and the resize landing while the menu is open, all seven tabs were read 3/3. |
| AC-3 | `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` at `f52f8b13e5`: 3/3, and 30/30 with `--repeat-each=10` (each test 10/10). |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. AC-1 was restated before this PR: the desktop test has no control.

Intake: `Prescription checked: test/playwright/e2e/portal/NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs — owns the concern`. The plugin treats a re-partition while the menu is closed as legitimate. No shared overflow-read helper exists: the 19 specs that touch the control keep local helpers.

## Test Evidence
- **Mechanism:** a per-frame probe at 390×664, CPU 4×. The control appears with four headers at 792 ms while the web font loads, the font finishes at 810 ms, and Medium moves back into the bar at 844 ms.
- **Red, old order:** the forced resize between the reads leaves `Medium` out of both, the CI signature, in 3 of 3 runs.
- **Green, committed helpers:** the same resize while the menu is open leaves one partition of seven tabs in 3 of 3 runs.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the commit hooks ran (secrets, whitespace, shorthand, JSDoc types, ticket-archaeology, block alignment, parse, derived-domain, fixed-sleeps).

None required: the spec runs in every engine-tier e2e run.
